reviews.text: I miss the old Imagine App before the Update !.. To Imagine App support, I'm writing to express my outrage and disappointment at the current state of your app. The generation limits are ridiculous, the token system is greedy, and the prices for premium plans are absurd. I'm still fuming about the fact that I can only get 150 "fast generations" and 1050 "generations" total for $4.99/week or $39.99/year on the standard plan, while the professional plan offers barely more at 250 "fast generations" and 1750 "generations" total for $9.99/week or $99.99/year. And don't even get me started on the "premium AI models" and "batch upscale" features that are supposed to justify these outrageous prices. But what really hurts is that I've lost the sense of control and freedom I once had with this app. I could express anything that came to my brain, generate images on a whim, and explore my creativity without limits.
